title: Ingest the owner-approved Robinhood disclosed-wallet cohort into the existing Memes v3 watched-wallet research lane
objective: Extend the existing Memes v3 implementation plan so collectors resolve the latest valid cumulative private MEMES_ALPHA_PRIVATE_SEED_V1 snapshot rather than hard-coding the original 2026-09-09 seed. The newly bound Robinhood cohort must enter the existing WATCH research universe privately, with deterministic intentional-buy classification, prospective freezing of new-token acquisitions after the public disclosure anchor, entity-independence checks, fixed-horizon outcomes and visibility/capacity research. Do not create a parallel scheduler, engine, alert stack, public watchlist, trade signal or portfolio authority.

evidence.summary: Public control-plane addendum binds the cohort, visibility anchor, WATCH semantics and no-trade/privacy boundaries without exposing identifiers.
Restricted cohort artifact contains the six exact Robinhood wallet identifiers, source claims, research mission and pre/post-disclosure protocol.
Latest cumulative private seed rolls forward the historical 2026-09-09 seed and adds the cohort without mutating predecessor evidence.

positive: Collector resolves the latest valid cumulative MEMES_ALPHA_PRIVATE_SEED_V1 snapshot by deterministic date/version ordering and preserves predecessor lineage.
The prior 2026-09-09 seed remains byte-for-byte historical evidence and is not rewritten when the 2026-09-11 seed is activated.
The private cohort is loaded into WATCH state with all exact identifiers available only to the restricted collector.
A deterministic intentional acquisition of a previously unseen token by a cohort wallet freezes a prospective research event row before later outcome attachment.
The frozen row preserves the 2026-09-10T13:27:08.086Z public-disclosure anchor and labels the wallet source as USER_SUPPLIED / external KOL research lead rather than autonomous discovery.
Two cohort wallets acquiring the same token creates a convergence research event only after duplicate/event dedupe and never assumes independence without entity-graph review.
1h/6h/24h/7d outcome attachment does not mutate the original event, wallet provenance, visibility anchor or entry timestamp.
Public health/readback exposes only counts, hashes, timestamps and state, never exact wallet identifiers or source-reported PnL values.
negative: The source post alone cannot produce QUALIFIED_ALPHA, BUY, SELL, position size or a user-facing high-signal alert.
Passive receipts, dust, spam and rewards from a cohort wallet do not create NEW_TOKEN_ACQUISITION or INTENTIONAL_BUY events.
No implementation may hard-code the 2026-09-09 seed as the permanent watchlist.
No implementation may publish the six exact cohort wallet addresses in public logs, artifacts, issues, health files or pull requests.
No address count may be treated as independent-entity count without graph evidence.
No new workflow/scheduler is created if the existing Memes v3 research cadence can consume the cohort.

forbidden_changes: new scheduler when existing Memes v3 cadence suffices
